verdict.rationale: Azure clearly ships first-party declarative IaC templates: ARM templates are documented as the way to implement infrastructure as code, and Bicep is a declarative DSL for deploying Azure resources. Terraform guidance is also documented, but Terraform is not a first-party typed framework. Missing for 10: a first-party typed CDK-style framework, documented state/rollback semantics for deployments, and independent hands-on corroboration of the template workflow.
